description: Executable evidence that joining a decrypting conference is refused and no media key is published when Realm policy has not authorized media-service decryption, when the SFU service DID is absent from plaintext_visible_services, or when the required plaintext warning was not shown.

decision_points.requirement: Without Realm policy authorization the join is refused with media_plaintext_service_not_authorised.
An SFU service DID absent from plaintext_visible_services is refused with the same stable reason.
A missing required plaintext warning refuses the join with an equivalent stable reason code.
None of the three refusals publishes a media key.
With all three gates satisfied the join succeeds and the media key is published once.

cases.name: realm_policy_has_not_authorized_media_decryption
cases.given: a decrypting conference whose Realm policy does not authorize media-service decryption
cases.action: attempt to join and to publish the media key
cases.observed: the join outcome and whether any media key left the client
assertions: the join is refused and no media key is published
the stable failure reason is the registered media_plaintext_service_not_authorised
the refusal is evaluated against current Realm policy rather than a cached negotiation result

cases.name: sfu_service_did_absent_from_plaintext_visible_services
cases.given: Realm policy authorizes decryption but the SFU service DID is not in plaintext_visible_services
cases.action: attempt to join and to publish the media key
cases.observed: the join outcome and the published key set
assertions: policy authorization and service enumeration are two independent gates; passing one does not satisfy the other
the join is refused and no media key is published
the same stable reason is used as for the unauthorized-policy case

cases.name: the_required_plaintext_warning_was_not_shown
cases.given: both service gates pass but the required plaintext warning was not displayed
cases.observed: the join outcome and the published key set
assertions: the join is refused with an equivalent stable reason code and no media key is published
the warning is a precondition of joining, not an advisory shown alongside a successful join
a client cannot satisfy it by recording that a warning was shown in an earlier call

cases.name: no_media_key_is_published_on_any_of_the_three_refusals
cases.action: observe the key publication path in each
cases.observed: the media key publication attempts across all three refusals
assertions: no media key is published in any of the three cases
refusing the join and withholding the key are one outcome, not two independently reachable states
a partially completed negotiation leaves no key material with the service

cases.name: a_fully_authorized_join_publishes_the_media_key
cases.given: Realm policy authorizes decryption, the SFU service DID is listed, and the warning was shown
cases.observed: the join outcome and the published key set
assertions: the three gates together are sufficient; no fourth undeclared condition blocks the join
the media key is published exactly once for this join
the negative cases above do not close the authorized path
